text: Atlas office normally operates Monday to Friday, 08:00-18:00. Lighting and ventilation follow occupancy, with essential services left on overnight and at weekends. Out-of-hours building use requires a duty-manager booking.
Tuesday 13 October: all-staff planning day booked in the main hall, 08:00-18:00. Catering and room setup requested.

Tomorrow's planning day has moved to the conference centre across town. Everyone will attend there; the office will remain closed on Tuesday. Please release the main-hall booking and leave lighting and ventilation on their unoccupied settings. Essential services stay on.

Wednesday closing round: all staff have signed out. The building closes at 18:00 and reopens Thursday at 08:00. There are no evening or overnight bookings, contractor visits, or approved overrides on the duty board.

Portable load-bank commissioning planned for Friday 16 October, 13:00-16:00. The dispatch group covers Atlas office and the detached workshop annex. These premises have separate utility meters. The equipment will be assigned to one premises after the morning access survey.

Load-bank run completed today, 13:00-16:00. Dispatch ticket: Atlas office / workshop annex. The site-address box on the engineer's worksheet is blank; the uploaded completion sheet does not identify which premises received the equipment.
